model.layer_types_note: Qwen3ForCausalLM has no layer_types field: every block is full attention (dense transformer). registry.layer_types() falls back to all-full_attention and records the fallback.
model.block_indexing: zero-based block-output indexing; ActivationRecorder stores the output of block l; hooks write block outputs

J_NP.note: released Qwen3-32B Jacobian lens (Salesforce-wikitext); note this is the default-n fit, not the n1000 fit used for the primary model
J_NP.provenance: neuronpedia/jacobian-lens qwen3-32b/jlens/Salesforce-wikitext/Qwen3-32B_jacobian_lens.pt is a fit() CHECKPOINT (jacobian_sum, n_done=80); finalised here as J = jacobian_sum / n_done and saved locally. n_prompts=80 vs 1000 for the primary model's lens; the review's own replication used n=25, so a partial fit is usable, and lens quality is a scope note, not a confound, because every contrast is within-model.
